street_name: Senator House 85 Queen Victoria Street London EC4V 4AB
description: Observations on Change of use of floors within the existing Office Building (Class E) for flexible use for continued Class E use or a combination of office floors with 1-2 levels for flexible use for conference and education use (Class F1) and associated internal and external alterations, including excavation of existing car park to provide a courtyard garden at level 0; alterations to level 0 eastern facade to provide doors and windows onto courtyard garden; reduction of existing car parking spaces from 8 to 4; installation of new cycle parking; enhanced end-of- trip facilities; replacement of existing window fenestrations and windows on Upper Thames Street and Fye Foot Lane; alterations to Level 2 entrances on Queen Victoria Street; and alterations to existing roof terrace [City of London application ref: 25/01596/FULL].
